text: Hilton's common stock began trading publicly on the NYSE under the symbol HLT on December 12, 2013, and Hilton Worldwide is listed on the New York Stock Exchange.
short: Hilton has been listed on the NYSE (HLT) since December 2013.

source.name: Hilton Worldwide Holdings Inc. – Form 10-K for fiscal 2013 (SEC)
source.quote: Our common stock began trading publicly on the NYSE under the symbol "HLT" on December 12, 2013

additionalSources.name: Hilton investor relations: FAQ
additionalSources.quote: Hilton Worldwide is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE).
